name: lazyspec
description: Let the agent experiment, then write the requirement. Specifications are locked, so an agent can never rewrite your requirements to match what it built.
//hooks: Cursor's event names and payload differ from Claude Code's, so this is a separate file. The guard reads the payload with patterns rather than parsing it, and refuses anything it cannot reduce to a target path, so an unfamiliar payload shape errs toward refusing rather than toward letting a write through.
